messages:
Alex: Quick poll — semver and YAML go on a date. Who spills the wine first? 🥂
Pria: YAML, 100%. Tabs + wine = disaster :sweat_smile:
Jordan: Semver would dramatically exit at the first minor incompatible accent. "It's not you, it's v2.0.0" :laughing:
Sam: I once had a config that ghosted me because of a stray dash. still trauma.
build-bot: CI: :warning: Failed to parse config.yaml: indentation error at line 12
Alex: ```yaml
server:
  port: 8080
  routes:
   - path: /health
     method: GET
```
Priya: there's the culprit — that dash is having an identity crisis. run a linter :eyes:
Jordan: also the compiler chimed in: "I refuse to be blamed for human indentation sins" :robot_face:
Sam: New rule: any PR with >3 YAML lines gets a complimentary bottle of wine. :wine_glass:
Alex: vote recorded. will codify as semver-friendly office policy v0.0.1-alpha :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
build-bot: :white_check_mark: joke policy added to handbook (kidding) — but I did add a linter step to the CI.
Priya: bless the linter. :pray:
Jordan: can we also make semver apologize for breaking plans? :pleading_face:
Sam: only if semver promises not to change major at midnight.
Alex: Deal. Also, meme attached: https://imgur.com/somefakeurl (pls don't actually click)
Priya: :rofl: perfect
build-bot: Archiving thread under random/memes/yaml_vs_semver
